stem: 人工智能(AI)和机器学习(ML)程序有助于在反洗钱合规中采用基于风险的方法,具体体现在:(选择三项.)

options.A: 自动生成可疑活动报告(SAR),无需人工审核
options.B: 高级客户风险评估,将客户背景信息与额外数据综合起来进行分析
options.C: 查明看似毫无关联的客户之间存在的联系,这些客户建立了复杂的网络用于洗钱
options.D: 自动调整客户的风险阈值,无需任何人工干预
options.E: 交易中复杂洗钱模式的检测

stem_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) procedures help in applying a risk-based approach in AML compliance through: (Select three.)

options_en.A: Automatically generating Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) without the need for human review
options_en.B: Advanced customer risk assessments that synthesize client background information with additional data
options_en.C: Identification of links among apparently unrelated clients who have established complex networks for money laundering
options_en.D: Automatically adapting risk thresholds for customers without any human intervention
options_en.E: Detection of complex money laundering patterns in transactions
